mapper.sql: rpt01_daily_id AS daily_id , rpt01_date AS date , rpt01_content AS content , rpt01_note AS note , rpt01_person_id AS person_id , COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '' ELSE '확인' END AS confirm_yn_name , f_emp_kor_nm(rpt01_confirmer_id) AS confirm_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rpt01_daily (rpt01_daily_id, rpt01_company_id, rpt01_date, rpt01_content, rpt01_note, rpt01_person_id) VALUES (#{dailyId}, #{companyId}, #{req.date}, #{req.content}, #{req.note}, #{personId})
mapper.select: SELECT daily_id, person_org, person_id, person_nm AS person_name, date, content, confirm_note, confirm_yn, confirm_yn_name FROM ( SELECT rpt01_daily_id AS daily_id , f_get_emptrans(rpt01_person_id, rpt01_date, 'org_code_nm') AS person_org , rpt01_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(rpt01_person_id) AS person_nm , rpt01_date AS date , rpt01_content AS content , rpt01_confirm_note AS confirm_note , COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '' ELSE '확인' END AS confirm_yn_name , CAST(f_get_empTrans(rpt01_person_id, rpt01_date, 'org_code_id') AS numeric) AS org_id , f_get_empTrans(rpt01_person_id, rpt01_date, 'org_cd') AS org_cd , f_get_empTrans(rpt01_person_id, rpt01_date, 'pos_cd') AS pos_cd FROM rpt01_daily WHERE ( ( #{unconfirmedOnly} = 'true' AND COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn,'false') = 'false' ) OR ( #{unconfirmedOnly} = 'false' ) ) AND rpt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND rpt01_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{closeDate}::date ) t WHERE CONCAT(person_org, person_nm, content) ILIKE #{searchText} AND org_id IN ( /** 기준일, 회사id, 조직코드를 받아서 down방향으로 조직코드 리스트를 구한다 */ WITH RECURSIVE org_tree_down(org00_org_code_id, org00_parent_code_id, org00_kor_nm, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.org00_org_code_id, a.org00_parent_code_id, a.org00_kor_nm, 0, ARRAY[a.org00_kor_nm::text], false FROM org00_org_info a WHERE 1=1 AND org00_company_id = #{companyId} AND org00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND org00_mod_date = (SELECT max(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId} AND f_trunc(org00_mod_date) <= f_trunc(#{startDate})) UNION ALL SELECT a.org00_org_code_id, a.org00_parent_code_id, a.org00_kor_nm, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, a.org00_kor_nm::text), a.org00_kor_nm = any(b.path) FROM org00_org_info a, org_tree_down b WHERE 1=1 AND a.org00_parent_code_id = b.org00_org_code_id AND a.org00_company_id = #{companyId} AND not cycle ) SELECT a.org00_org_code_id FROM org_tree_down a ) ORDER BY org_cd, pos_cd, person_nm, date

SELECT rpt01_daily_id AS daily_id , f_get_emptrans(rpt01_person_id, rpt01_date, 'org_code_nm') AS person_org , rpt01_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(rpt01_person_id) AS person_name , rpt01_date AS date , rpt01_content AS content , rpt01_confirm_note AS confirm_note , COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(rpt01_confirm_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '' ELSE '확인' END AS confirm_yn_name FROM rpt01_daily WHERE rpt01_daily_id = #{dailyId} AND rpt01_company_id = #{companyId}
